notes: Independent check 2026-11-15: removed entries whose only source was an aggregator or directory listing (Minsk City Veterinary Station, Gomel City Veterinary Station, PoliVet Gomel, Grodno City Veterinary Station, Azbukavet Grodno, Mogilev City Veterinary Station); Azbukavet 24 h claim was only on the veterinar.by card and its own site was not opened. Zheleznodorozhnaya branch of Bazylevsky downgraded (contradictory hours on page). No official duty-rota page and no animal poison line page found. Regions outside Minsk have no entries (Brest, Vitebsk, Gomel, Grodno, Mogilev: no own clinic page opened). Planned Minsk City Vet Station 24 h clinic at Pobediteley 155 not yet open.
